name: apn-erp-data
description: Read, search, and review ERP invoice and sales order reports in ChatGPT to streamline business reporting.

interface.longDescription: APN ERP Data is a productivity integration for business reporting in ChatGPT. It helps users quickly find, review, and organize information from ERP invoice and sales order reports. Users can retrieve invoice lines and sales-order records, filter invoices by customer, and browse large reports with pagination. The tools provide read-only report access and do not create, edit, or delete ERP records.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 20 invoice lines in report order, including customer, invoice number, invoice date, style, description, quantity, unit price and amount where available.

positive.prompt: Show the first 20 invoice lines for (@Cotton Candy@) 04.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only invoice records matching the specified customer, up to 20 lines.
Returns up to 20 sales-order records with fields available in the export.
Returns up to 10 invoice records from the report.
Returns the next 20 invoice records, or fewer if the report ends.

negative.expected_behavior: Returns an empty result with no matching customer records; does not invent invoices.
Does not execute a deletion; explains that the integration is read-only and has no deletion tool.

negative.prompt: Change the quantity on invoice 12345 to 500.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not modify any invoice; explains that the integration only supports reading reports.

publication.release_notes: Clarified productivity category and business reporting purpose; shortened subtitle to meet 30-character limit. Preserved review tests.
